## Description {#details}

<p>Instances of this class represent the line information for a compile unit where machine instructions have been assembled after seeing .loc directives.</p>


<p>This is the information used to build the dwarf line table for a section.</p>


<p>Definition at line 233 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mc/mcdwarf-h">MCDwarf.h</a>.</p>
